name: Omni Analytics
description: Query Omni using the same semantic model, permissions, and logic defined by your data team directly from Claude. Instantly answer questions about your business using natural language — no need to write SQL or navigate complex dashboards. Your Omni semantic model becomes Claude's knowledge of your data, enabling secure, governed, and consistent analytics workflows across your organization.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Omni Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Omni Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://callbacks.omniapp.co/callback/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Omni Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omni Analytics provides these MCP tools: pickModel, pickTopic, and getData.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Omni Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Omni Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Omni Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Omni Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Omni Analytics is developed by Omni Analytics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
